phase_name: Extraction Pass 3 and First Mid-Series Filter Check

objectives.description: Confirm at least 24 hours since Pass-2 timestamp
Run the pass via systemctl --user start sapience-sync.service, bounded poll, journal read, before/after pair, Pass-3 block appended
Compute and record two-filter ratio at each reading so far

notes: Pass 3 completed cleanly: 0 extract errors, 2010 objects staged (40.2/chunk, richest pass yet), 47min 58.5s wall clock (longest run so far, still under the 60-min cap). 'would ingest now' held flat at 134 before and after -- the second consecutive pass with zero visible backlog reduction despite active extraction. The pass's own cumulative daily yield (2051) exceeded the stated 2000-object cap with no evidence of truncation -- all 50 chunks ran to completion regardless. The two-filter ratio (subagent/harness-started vs headless/agent) is stable at 30.13x-31.45x across all 5 coverage readings in the ledger so far, confirming the asymmetry reports/02 first observed from one reading. The dispatch itself arrived ~16 seconds before the 24-hour gate on the Pass-2 timestamp had elapsed; non-gated setup work (reading the plan, checking lock/state files) consumed enough wall time that the gate had cleared before any phase-3 task was attempted.
